_comment: Pen tool on the UR5e flange: the one place the marking node and the collision model
read the tool from (notes/pen_marking_plan.md, milestone 1). Frame: tool0, metres.
tool0 +Z points out of the flange along the pen; the camera bracket is on the side
OPPOSITE the end-effector connector. Every primitive is a CONSERVATIVE envelope of the
holder (penholder_assembly.step): correct it against the RViz markers
(tool_model_marker_node.py) and against a touch-off for the tip.
pen_tip_m: user-measured ~0.19 m from the flange (2026-09-22); refine by touch-off.
camera: pose from the hand-eye calibration file (tool0 -> camera_color_optical_frame);
body_m is the D435i (90 x 25 x 25 mm) with margin, centred on the optical origin
because which side of the origin the body extends to is not known here.
